patch_list: Redirects Zotero's sync API and live-update stream to your own server.
Custom sync server: allow cleartext streaming
Adds the chosen streaming host to the app's cleartext allow-list when the stream URL is ws:// or http://.
For development only. Plants Timber's debug tree so the app's own log lines reach logcat — expect a lot of output, and do not patch this into a build you rely on.
Recover attachments with an unusable modification time

Temporary workaround: the Zotero Android app discards an attachment whose stored modification time it cannot parse, instead of repairing it, so the file is never uploaded. Reported upstream: https://github.com/zotero/zotero-android/issues/…
